adjudication_rule: Single-owner screening; no invented second reviewer. Conflicts resolved by track owner. Unavailable full text = unresolved retrieval, not exclusion.

eligibility_criteria.label: Tobacco/nicotine policy model with empirical parameters
eligibility_criteria.description: Study presents or uses a tobacco/nicotine policy model with empirical parameters (not purely theoretical)

eligibility_criteria.label: Measurement/calibration evidence for nicotine/tobacco WBE
eligibility_criteria.description: Study provides measurement or calibration evidence for nicotine/tobacco wastewater-based epidemiology

eligibility_criteria.label: Incremental decision value of measurement
eligibility_criteria.description: Study quantifies incremental decision value of wastewater measurement over existing surveillance

eligibility_criteria.label: NZ/AU public datasets and policy implementation
eligibility_criteria.description: Study uses NZ or AU public datasets (health surveys, tobacco/vaping returns, trade, prices, customs, wastewater, health outcomes, cessation, costs)

eligibility_criteria.label: Health, HR-QoL, cost, equity, diffusion, competition methods
eligibility_criteria.description: Study provides methods for health outcomes, HR-QoL/QALY, costs, equity, diffusion, or competition that can fill a specified model component

eligibility_criteria.label: Wrong exposure
eligibility_criteria.description: Study does not address tobacco, nicotine, smoking, vaping, or related nicotine products

eligibility_criteria.label: Wrong decision/method
eligibility_criteria.description: Study does not present a policy model, simulation, decision analysis, cost-effectiveness, VOI, or measurement calibration method

eligibility_criteria.label: No transferable component
eligibility_criteria.description: Study has no transferable measurement, calibration, cost, or policy component for NZ/AU context

eligibility_criteria.label: Duplicate report
eligibility_criteria.description: Same study reported in multiple publications (journal + conference, preprint + published, erratum + original)

eligibility_criteria.label: Superseded edition
eligibility_criteria.description: Superseded edition of a study (retained as context, not as independent evidence)

eligibility_criteria.label: Inaccessible original
eligibility_criteria.description: Original full text inaccessible after reasonable retrieval attempts (pending, not exclusion)

eligibility_criteria.label: Pure non-nicotine drug WBE
eligibility_criteria.description: Pure non-nicotine drug wastewater-based epidemiology without transferable measurement component

eligibility_criteria.label: Individual clinical diagnosis
eligibility_criteria.description: Individual clinical diagnosis study without population-level policy/measurement relevance

eligibility_criteria.label: Unrelated environmental toxicity
eligibility_criteria.description: Unrelated environmental toxicity study without tobacco/nicotine relevance

eligibility_criteria.label: Review/WHO compilation as independent measurement
eligibility_criteria.description: Review or WHO compilation cited as independent measurement of upstream surveys (aids discovery only, not independent)

eligibility_criteria.label: Industry funding without data access
eligibility_criteria.description: Industry-funded study without data access for verification

notes: Single-owner screening explicit; no invented second reviewer.
Unavailable full text = unresolved retrieval, not evidence of ineligibility.
Exclusion codes: E01-E11 map to systematic-search.md exclusion codes.
Record operator, time, criterion, and reason for each decision.
Preserve parents, additions/removals, changed queries and screening amendments.
Re-screen affected records on source revision/retraction or policy baseline change.
